buffers.arrive: Arrives the day before embarkation (7:00 am flight lands 9:12 am; hotel check-in is usually mid-afternoon, so plan luggage storage).

coverage.flights: Alaska Airlines is the only carrier with ABQ-SEA nonstops in the results (2 each way). Fares were read on Google Flights for 4 adults, not on Alaska's own site, so they are 'published', not verified. Six date pairs were searched (Jun 11-19, 14-22, 16-24, 18-26, 19-27, 24-Jul 2), covering the lead Saturday, Sunday, Tuesday, Thursday and Friday sailings. The same $1,588 nonstop fare appeared for every pair. Southwest, Delta, United and American showed no nonstop and were not priced separately.
coverage.hotels: 9 hotels for the night of Jun 11 2027 (before the Sat Jun 12 sailings). Rates are 1 room, 2 guests as listed on Google Hotels; two-room totals are planner estimates (2 x rate). Taxes, fees, transfer costs and photos were not captured. Other nights (Jun 18, 19, 24 etc.) were not searched, so those rates will differ.
notCaptured: Hotel prices for nights other than Jun 11 2027
